title: Add holiday
purpose: Add a day the laboratory is closed to a business calendar, so clocks on that calendar do not run on it.
summary: Add a closed day to a business calendar. Clocks that count in that calendar do not run on it. Only the admin role can open this form.

tasks.title: Add a holiday
steps: Choose the [[Date]] and enter the [[Holiday name]].
Select [[Add holiday]]. The calendar's page opens with the holiday listed.

tasks.title: Correct a holiday entered wrongly
steps: Go back to the calendar and remove the holiday with a reason, then add it again with the right date.

good_to_know: A calendar can have only one holiday on a date.
A holiday closes the whole day. Intervals written for that date do not count.
An overnight shift written as 22:00-24:00 on the evening before is not closed by a holiday on the next day.
Due times already worked out are not recounted. The holiday applies when a due time is worked out afterwards.

items.label: Date
items.description: Required. A calendar date, chosen with the date picker.

items.label: Holiday name
items.description: Required, up to 120 characters. Surrounding spaces are removed.

items.label: Add holiday
items.description: Adds the holiday and records who added it. A second holiday on the same date is refused with a message beside the date. There is no reason field when adding, and there is no edit: remove it and add it again.

items.label: Cancel
items.description: Returns to the calendar's page without saving.
